description.en-US: The life of the paralysed mystic Lydwine of Schiedam (1380-1433), whom Thomas knew of and wrote up from the earlier life by Jan Brugman, in two parts: her sufferings and virtues, and her spiritual consolations, ecstasies and death, with the miracles recorded after it. The Latin is Pohl's edition (Opera omnia VI, 1905, from a raw OCR of the printed volume); the English is V. Scully (1912), made from it and following its chapters.
description.pt-BR: A vida da mística paralítica Lidwina de Schiedam (1380-1433), que Tomás compôs a partir da vida anterior de Jan Brugman, em duas partes: sofrimentos e virtudes; consolações espirituais, êxtases e morte, com os milagres.
description.la: Vita Lidewigis virginis, duabus partibus: de patientia et virtutibus eius; de consolationibus spiritualibus, raptibus et obitu, cum miraculis. Textus ex editione Pohl (1905), cum versione Anglica V. Scully (1912).

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Vita Lidewigis virginis, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1905), Opera omnia VI, pp. 313-453; archive.org raw OCR (Google scan).
sources.description: Prologue and the 23 + 33 chapters in two parts, with Pohl's chapter titles taken from the chapter heads and recased. Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical footnotes and the epilegomena are not imported. Raw OCR: drop capitals at chapter openings eat the first letters of the opening lines; common slips and the line-start fragments were repaired by script against a lexicon of the Latin corpus, but some remain.

sources.edition: St. Lydwine of Schiedam, by Thomas a Kempis, tr. Vincent Scully (London: Burns & Oates / Edinburgh: Ballantyne 1912), from Pohl's text; archive.org OCR.
sources.description: The prologue and 23 chapters of Part I and the prologue and 33 chapters of Part II, plus the closing miracles. The translator's introduction is not imported. Raw OCR: the translator's footnotes stand inline at the end of their paragraphs or pages, and hyphenations at line ends may remain.

title.en-US: Prologue to the Life of Lydwine
title.la: Prologus in vitam Lidewigis virginis

title.en-US: Part I: Her sufferings and virtues
title.la: Pars prima: de patientia et virtutibus eius
1. De loco et nativitate Lidewigis virginis, et probitate parentum eius
title.en-US: 1. Of the birthplace and birth of the Virgin Lydwine, and the probity of her parents

title.la: 2. De devotione eius ad imaginem beatae Virginis
title.en-US: 2. Of her devotion to the image of the blessed Virgin

title.la: 3. De firmo proposito eius in statu virginitatis
title.en-US: 3. Of her strong purpose in the state of virginity

title.la: 4. De initio infirmitatis eius et occasione longae aegritudinis
title.en-US: 4. Of the beginning of her weak ness, and the occasion of her long illness

title.la: 5. De sententia cuiusdam medici, et miraculoso facto circa eam
title.en-US: 5. Of the opinion of a certain doctor, and the miracle that befell her

title.la: 6. De modicitate refectionis eius per plures annos
title.en-US: 6. Of the scantiness of her nourishment for many years

title.la: 7. De variis languoribus et doloribus eam die noctuque torquentibus
title.en-US: 7. Of the various illnesses and pains that tormented her day and night

title.la: 8. De gravitate febrium et nova molestia in crure eius
title.en-US: 8. Of the severity of her fever and a fresh disease in her leg

title.la: 9. De duritia lectuli eius, et frigoribus in hieme perpessis
title.en-US: 9. Of the hardness of her bed and the cold she suffered in winter

title.la: 10. De vigiliis eius et luctamine contra somnolentiam
title.en-US: 10. Of her watchings and struggle against sleep

title.la: 11. De paupertate et sustinentia patris eius
title.en-US: 11. Of the poverty and endurance of her father

title.la: 12. De illusione satanae qui patrem eius in fossam detrusit
title.en-US: 12. Of the illusion of satan who cast her father into a ditch

title.la: 13. De obitu patris eius in profesto conceptionis beatae Mariae Virginis
title.en-US: 13. Of the death of her father on the vigil of the conception of the blessed Virgin Mary

title.la: 14. De obitu Iohannis Petri avi eius, et longa continentia sua
title.en-US: 14. Of the death of John peters her grandfather and his long continence

title.la: 15. De morte Petronillae matris eius
title.en-US: 15. Of the death of petronilla her mother

title.la: 16. De statu eius post mortem matris, et misericordia in pauperes
title.en-US: 16. Of her state after her mother's death, and her pity for the poor

title.la: 17. De incendio lectuli eius quod ipsa una manu absque laesione extinxit
title.en-US: 17. Of the burning of her bed which she put out with one hand without any injury

title.la: 18. De cineribus in capite ieiunii ab angelo sibi ministratis
title.en-US: 18. Of the ashes ministered to her by an angel at the beginning of lent

title.la: 19. De vino in amphora divinitus procurato
title.en-US: 19. Of the wine miraculously placed in her cup

title.la: 20. De pecunia pro fratre suo soluta et in bursa multiplicata
title.en-US: 20. Of the money paid for her brother and multiplied in her purse

title.la: 21. De armo porcino pauperibus dato, et alio divinitus recuperato
title.en-US: 21. Of the ham given to the poor, and miraculously replaced by another

title.la: 22. De carnibus et pisis pauperibus missis et multiplicatis
title.en-US: 22. Of the meat and peas given to the poor, and multiplied

title.la: 23. De visione caelestis mensae eleemosynis pauperum repletae
title.en-US: 23. Of the vision of a heavenly table filled by the alms of the poor
Part II: Her consolations, death and miracles
title.la: Pars secunda: de consolationibus, obitu et miraculis

title.en-US: Prologue to the second part
title.la: Prologus secundae partis
1. De initio spiritualium consolationum eius per recordationem Dominicae passionis
title.en-US: 1. Of the beginning of her spiri tual consolations through the recollection of the Lord's passion

title.la: 2. De raptu eius in terram sanctam, et ad sacra loca urbis romanae
title.en-US: 2. Of her rapture into the Holy land, and to the sacred places of the city of rome

title.la: 3. De mirabili claritate et suavitate intra cellam eius apparentibus
title.en-US: 3. Of the wonderful brightness and sweetness appearing in her cell

title.la: 4. De visione in nocte Dominicae nativitatis, et ubertate lactis in uberibus eius
title.en-US: 4. Of the vision on christmas night, and the abundance of milk in her breasts

title.la: 5. De virga cypressina quam ei angelus attulit de paradiso
title.en-US: 5. Of the cypress rod which an angel brought her from para dise

title.la: 6. De privatione angelicae claritatis ob praesentiam alterius in cella eius latentis
title.en-US: 6. Of the bereavement of the heavenly brightness on account of another hiding in her cell

title.la: 7. De raptu eius ad loca purgatorii, et ad gaudia paradisi, unde sertum a beata virgine sibi datum reportavit
title.en-US: 7. Of her rapture to the regions of purgatory, and to the joys of paradise, whence she brought back a veil given her by the blessed Virgin

title.la: 8. De corona gloriosa sibi praeparata propter vituperia et vulnera a Picardis sibi inflicta
title.en-US: 8. Of the glorious crown prepared for her, because of the in sults and wounds inflicted on her by the men of picardy2

title.la: 9. De patientia et morte Petronillae neptis huius virginis
title.en-US: 9. Of the patience and death of petronilla, this Virgin's niece

title.la: 10. De subtractione consolationis divinae, quam virgo incurrebat, ob tristitiam neptis defunctae
title.en-US: 10. Of the withdrawal of divine consolation, which the Virgin suffered on account of her grief for her dead niece

title.la: 11. De devoto iuvene Gerardo eremita facto, et peregrinis eum visitantibus
title.en-US: 11. Of the devout youth Gerard, who had become a hermit, and of the pilgrims who visited him

title.la: 12. De felici obitu domini Wermboldi presbyteri, huius virginis fidelis amici
title.en-US: 12. Of the happy death of master wermbold, priest, this Virgin's faithful friend

title.la: 13. De diversis raptibus eius et cognitione de statu quorundam religiosorum
title.en-US: 13. Of her divers raptures and her knowledge of the state of certain religious

title.la: 14. De apparitione et cognitione angelicae claritatis circa eam
title.en-US: 14. Of the appearance and know ledge of the angelic bright ness about her

title.la: 15. De mirabili modo internae commotionis ante raptum Spiritus eius
title.en-US: 15. Of the wonderful manner of her interior pain before the rapture of her spirit

title.la: 16. De spiritu prophetiae eius, quo multa secreta aliis revelavit
title.en-US: 16. Of her spirit of prophecy, whereby she revealed to others many hidden things

title.la: 17. De quodam sacrista defuncto et aliis pluribus defunctis
title.en-US: 17. Of a certain departed sacristan and many other dead

title.la: 18. De cautela et circumspectione eius circa revelationem statuum defunctorum
title.en-US: 18. Of her caution and prudence concerning the revelation of the state of the departed

title.la: 19. De temptatione cuiusdam viri, consilio Virginis a laqueo diaboli liberati
title.en-US: 19. Of the temptation of a certain man, delivered by the advice of the Virgin from the snare of the devil

title.la: 20. De femina meritis beatae Mariae Virginis a fovea desperationis liberata
title.en-US: 20. Of a woman freed by the merits of the blessed Virgin Mary from the gulf of despair

title.la: 21. De gratia magnae compunctionis et larga effusione lacrimarum in communicatione corporis Christi
title.en-US: 21. Of her grace of great compunc tion and abundant shedding of tears in the communion of the body of Christ

title.la: 22. De insatiabili desiderio eius ad communicandum saepius et apparitione pueri crucifixi
title.en-US: 22. Of her insatiable desire to communicate often, and of the appearance of a child crucified

title.la: 23. De febre Baldewini pueri, et domini Iohannis confessoris sui
title.en-US: 23. Of the fever of the child bald- wine, and of master John her confessor

title.la: 24. De dolore calculi eius et praescientia ante diem obitus sui
title.en-US: 24. Of her suffering from stone and her foreknowledge before the day of her death

title.la: 25. De gratia in nocte paschali et prophetia mortis eius
title.en-US: 25. Of the grace on easter night and the prophecy of her death

title.la: 26. De felici obitu eius et doloribus in extremis
title.en-US: 26. Of her happy death and suffer ings at the last

title.la: 27. De mirabili dispositione bracchiorum eius, et involutione corporis
title.en-US: 27. Of the wonderful placing of her arms, and the shrouding of her body

title.la: 28. De mirabili decore et aspectu vultus eius
title.en-US: 28. Of the wonderful beauty and aspect of her countenance

title.la: 29. De concursu visitantium corpus eius defunctum
title.en-US: 29. Of the flocking of visitors to her dead body

title.la: 30. De maculis quas contraxit ex contactu immundorum hominum
title.en-US: 30. Of the stains which she contracted from unclean men

title.la: 31. De reverenda sepultura eius
title.en-US: 31. Of her reverential burial

title.la: 32. De miraculis post mortem eius
title.en-US: 32. Of the miracles after her death

title.la: 33. Narratio trium miraculorum
title.en-US: 33. The narration of three miracles
